prose: Google's own blog introduces Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar: by natively coupling its live dialogue capabilities with low-latency streaming video, Live Avatar brings near real-time visual presence to Gemini's conversational AI, pitched at enterprises and their users.
Building on last week's Gemini 3.8 Live launch, the September 24 post is by research scientist Shuo-yiin Chang and software engineer CJ Zheng on behalf of the Gemini Audio Team.
highlights: Google introduces Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar.
Couples live dialogue with low-latency streaming video.
Near real-time visual presence for enterprise conversational AI.
Follows last week's Gemini 3.8 Live launch.
From the Gemini Audio Team, September 24.
